john.13.p1.b1.text: It was now just before the Passover Feast, and Jesus knew that His hour had come to leave this world and return to the Father.

john.13.p1.b2.text: Having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the very end.

john.13.p1.b3.text: The evening meal was underway, and the devil had already put into the heart of Judas, … to betray Jesus.

john.13.p1.b4.text: So He got up from the supper, laid aside His outer garments, and wrapped a towel around His waist.

john.13.p2.b1.text: After that, He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and dry them with the towel that was around Him.

john.13.p2.b2.text: Lord, are You going to wash my feet?

john.13.p2.b3.text: You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.

john.13.p3.b1.text: Never shall You wash my feet!

john.13.p3.b2.text: Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.

john.13.p3.b3.text: … not only my feet, but my hands and my head as well!

john.13.p4.b1.text: Whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean.

john.13.p4.b2.text: And you are clean, though not all of you.

john.13.p4.b3.text: For He knew who would betray Him. That is why He said, “Not all of you are clean.”

john.13.p5.b1.text: When Jesus had washed their feet and put on His outer garments, He reclined with them again

john.13.p5.b2.text: Do you know what I have done for you?

john.13.p5.b3.text: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.

john.13.p6.b1.text: … no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.

john.13.p6.b2.text: If you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.

john.13.p6.b3.text: I know whom I have chosen.

john.13.p6.b4.text: But this is to fulfill the Scripture: ‘The one who shares My bread has lifted up his heel against Me.’

john.13.p7.b1.text: After Jesus had said this, He became troubled in spirit and testified,

john.13.p7.b2.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, one of you will betray Me.

john.13.p7.b3.text: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed as to which of them He meant.

john.13.p8.b1.text: One of His disciples, the one whom Jesus loved, was reclining at His side.

john.13.p8.b2.text: So Simon Peter motioned to him to ask Jesus which one He was talking about.

john.13.p9.b1.text: It is the one to whom I give this morsel after I have dipped it.

john.13.p9.b2.text: Then He dipped the morsel and gave it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot.

john.13.p9.b3.text: And when Judas had taken the morsel, Satan entered into him.

john.13.p9.b4.text: What you are about to do, do quickly.

john.13.p10.b1.text: But no one at the table knew why Jesus had said this to him.

john.13.p10.b2.text: Since Judas kept the money bag, some thought that Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the feast, or to give something to the poor.

john.13.p10.b3.text: As soon as he had received the morsel, Judas went out

john.13.p11.b1.text: Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him.

john.13.p11.b2.text: Little children, I am with you only a little while longer.

john.13.p11.b3.text: You will look for Me, … ‘Where I am going, you cannot come.’

john.13.p12.b1.text: A new commandment I give you: Love one another.

john.13.p12.b2.text: As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.

john.13.p12.b3.text: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.”

john.13.p13.b2.text: Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now,

john.13.p14.b1.text: Lord, … why can’t I follow You now? I will lay down my life for You.

john.13.p14.b2.text: Will you lay down your life for Me?

john.13.p14.b4.text: before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.
